mapper.select: SELECT i.item_code value,i.name label,i.description,i.sort_order sortOrder FROM sys_dict_item i JOIN sys_dict_type t ON t.type_code=i.type_code LEFT JOIN sys_dict_type parent ON parent.type_code=t.parent_type_code WHERE t.type_code=#{typeCode} AND t.status='ENABLED' AND i.status='ENABLED' AND (t.parent_type_code IS NULL OR parent.status='ENABLED') ORDER BY i.sort_order,i.id
